errors.trigger: No explicit existing-project opt-in, change goal, or repository root
errors.diagnosis: Discovery requires opt-in plus a concrete goal; neither can be inferred
errors.rescue_action: Halt and state exactly which input is missing
errors.user_message: Existing-project discovery needs an explicit opt-in, a repository root, and a concrete change goal.

errors.trigger: Repository root escapes the working repository or profile path is unsafe
errors.diagnosis: Resolved inspection or write path leaves the allowed boundary
errors.rescue_action: Halt and report the offending path; do not inspect or write
errors.user_message: Discovery path is unsafe. Provide a repository-relative root inside the working repository.

errors.trigger: Inspection command or profile write fails
errors.diagnosis: Filesystem or subprocess failure during read-only discovery
errors.rescue_action: Leave files untouched where possible and report what failed
errors.user_message: Discovery failed partway. Nothing was modified. Retry once the reported error is fixed.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Run update violates the run-object schema or gate contract
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not write
errors.user_message: Run update failed validation. See validator output; nothing was written.
